pages.title: Basic Operations
pages.text:
Right-click a doll to open its inventory — equip weapons, armor, and tools.

Baton: right-click a doll to select it, then right-click blocks to set a work area. Shift-right-click the doll to clear it.

Remote: right-click anywhere to open the control panel for managing all dolls' modes and follow status.

Baton is crafted from 3 sticks. Remote is 2 iron ingots + 1 redstone. See "Baton & Remote" entry.

pages.title: Life and Death
pages.text:
When a doll dies, it drops all items. All corresponding eggs become invalid. A dead doll cannot be recovered.

Right-click a doll with its egg to retrieve it safely at any time.
